changes: New “?” button: it shows this list of changes.
New mode: addition and subtraction up to 4 digits.
New scratch pad for 3- and 4-digit sums. Write with a finger or Apple Pencil.
4-digit questions get three times as much time.
New home button to go back to the Kids Portal.
After a second wrong try, the app shows the correct answer and moves on.
Wrong answers now show in red.
The keypad stays above the Safari toolbar on iPhone.
Menu buttons are easier to read, and the status bar is simpler.
The back button is bigger and asks before it drops your score.
First version: addition, subtraction and times tables with a timer and streaks.
